title: Designer adjustments from the data-feasibility review (17 items)
description:
Companion to the design story ship-4a59a1 (a story cannot parent a story, so this sits beside it under the same initiative). A review of the design against what the Papyrus and Biblicus platforms can deliver produced the adjustments below, in priority order. Send them to the designer as one batch; tick each when it is answered in the design.

Related: voting pilot ship-b35fa2; Papyrus initiatives PPY-77bb3b (collaborative steering) and PPY-428252 (public knowledge base); Biblicus epic blbs-d380cb.

## Checklist
- [ ] 1. Design the cold start. States for under 4 weeks of history (no sparkline, no percent, chip says "new"), 4 to 7 weeks (sparkline, no percent), 8 or more (full). The 26-week chart appears only after 12 weeks; before that show the weekly bars available, titled with the real span. Show an empty Rising / Emerging section gracefully.
- [ ] 2. Define "change %" and write it on the page. Use "items in the last 4 weeks versus the prior 4 weeks" and show the absolute counts beside the percent; drop the percent when the prior period is under 5. (The sample percentages do not follow from the sample series.)
- [x] 3. Minimum-n states for scores and the gap value. Under 5 ratings in a dimension show "n=3, too few" and a dash for the gap. Rank only items with a floor of votes, or show them under "New". Decide how an item with 2 of 4 dimensions rated appears.
- [x] 4. Separate "Upvote" from "Ratings" clearly. Label the two numbers (for example "412 upvotes" and "188 rated it"). Show the editor mean as its own labelled figure and state which one the headline score uses.
- [x] 5. Show data freshness. Numbers update on a schedule, not live: add "Updated 4 min ago" to the board and Rising; make "votes per hour" a 6-hour window; the user's own vote updates optimistically.
- [ ] 6. Reduce the launch entity vocabulary to eight kinds (maker, model family, task, technique, licence, concept, platform, dataset). Remove "signal" (waitlist only, coming soon) from chips; use an evidence flag on the item. Four launch relations only (made by, built on, measured by, replaces) plus successor and publishes on the item page.
- [x] 7. Submit flow: make extraction asynchronous. After "Submit for checking" show the item as Pending with "We are reading the link"; the entity confirm / fix / remove step arrives when extraction finishes (or on the item page for the submitter). The duplicate check stays synchronous (exact canonical URL and same-domain recent list). "Save draft" is stored in the browser only; say so.
- [ ] 8. Wiki page: read-only controls. Replace "Edit wiki", "History", "Discuss" and "6 contributors" with "Suggest an edit" (sends to the desk), "Updated 19 Oct" and a "Graph JSON" link. Add a visible stamp for "reviewed by the desk" versus "draft, not yet reviewed" so generated text never looks attested.
- [ ] 9. Insights block: desk-only at launch. Remove Agree / Disagree counts and reader authors for now (or mark them a later state). Keep "Cites N items" and "From a graph query".
- [x] 10. Item page graph block. Drop "from N comments" sources and "2 corrections by readers" until those exist; sources are "evidence link" or "item text". Use "confirmed by the desk" only.
- [x] 11. Comments: make the whole Talk column and thread optional. The board and item page must look finished with comments off. (Comments are wanted; they ship in a later phase.)
- [x] 12. Status marks and the Shipped rule. For v1: "an editor confirmed it, or 3 signed-in readers reported using it". Verified = editor checked; Vapor = editor stamp. Show who stamped and when.
- [ ] 13. Fix the vocabulary: one name per thing. Section (the three types), Beat (root topics), Topic (any entity or concept), Subtopic (child of a beat), Cluster (model-found, unnamed). "ALL 214 TOPICS" mixes them; each is a different data source.
- [x] 14. Roundup. Cards become table rows plus status words, frozen at publish. Add a visible "scores as of DATE" line. Previous / next and "All roundups" stay. Draw email subscribe as a future state beside RSS.
- [x] 15. Concept of the week is an editor pick; remove "Edited by 9".
- [x] 16. Composite score and ranking explainer. Show the formula once decided (how editor and reader scores combine is an open exploration, Papyrus PPY-1bf366), including any time decay for Front versus this-week ranks.
- [x] 17. Karma. Karma is needed and is being defined (Papyrus PPY-231533). Until it is a defined number, show submission count and account age.

## Acceptance
```gherkin
Feature: Design reflects platform limits
  Scenario: Every adjustment answered
    Given the designer received this checklist
    When the revised design is delivered
    Then each of the 17 items is ticked with a note of how the design answers it
    And the implementation story can start from the revised design
```

comments.text: Board reconciliation 2026-10-22 (live checks 10:30-10:45Z). Left open: no evidence that the 17-item checklist went to the designer or came back ticked. Seen live and consistent with it: item 5 (data freshness: 'Updated every 6 hours' plus the Freshness label), item 8 (wiki: 'Suggest an edit' form instead of edit controls, 'Edited by AI' stamp). The rest are unverified.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Site-side items done in Shipped-web PR #44 (live 2026-10-22) plus the policies page (CMS item-policies v3). 3: sample item shows 'n=3, too few' and a dash for the gap; real items show reader means through the Rating island, which has NO floor: it prints 'Readers: 3.8 from 3 ratings'. Gap for Papyrus: apply the 5-rating floor in the island (and show the 'rated it' count). 4: board help text, Readers key on every item, rail note say upvotes, ratings and editor score are separate and the editor score is the headline. Island labels: upvotes yes, 'N rated it' no (Papyrus shows 'from N ratings'). 5: boards carry the Freshness island; Votes / hr says '6-hour window'. 7: submit page says Pending while we read the link and that the draft stays in this browser; the Submit island already did both. 10: sample item uses 'evidence link' / 'item text'. 11: zero-comment state on real items reads 'No comments yet.'; sample Talk cell is a dash. 12: stamp note per verdict from verdictBy/verdictAt, silent otherwise; Shipped rule in rails, submit and policies (the 3-readers path is applied by an editor today; no automation). 14: roundup cards are table rows with status words, 'scores as of Fri 23 Oct 2026, frozen'; subscribe left to the email lead. 16: policies #ranking states the formula (editor composite, 48 h half-life, 0.5/0.5 once 5+ ratings); home Latest is still newest-first and the policy says so. 17: sign-in page and policies #karma define karma; wording follows Papyrus (upvotes on submissions incl. pending, +2 per used-it), not 'promoted submissions'.

comments.text: Owned by the knowledge lead, left alone: 1 (cold-start states: rail note describes them; the strip still shows '+50%' chips on young topics, lead to check against the 8-week rule), 2 (change % definition is in the rail note; lead to confirm counts beside percents), 6 (entity vocabulary; static Rising/Vapor samples still carry 'signal' chips), 8 (wiki: Suggest an edit, Updated date and data JSON link are live; no 'reviewed by an editor' vs draft stamp seen), 9 (insights), 13 (home still reads 'All 282 topics', mixing kinds). Item 15 ticked: live concept of the week reads 'Edited by AI on 2026-10-22', no 'Edited by 9'.
